summary: Join our Global Disaster Risk Reduction Frameworks Training to gain essential knowledge and skills for effective disaster management and resilience building.
lede: Global disaster risk reduction frameworks connect risk analysis with policy, preparedness and long-term resilience planning. For disaster-management, infrastructure, climate and development professionals, the course covers interpreting framework priorities, assessing multi-hazard risk, aligning policies and projects with climate and development goals, and using indicators to inform planning, budgets and progress reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals who influence or implement disaster risk strategies, ensuring that their plans align with global DRR frameworks.
audience: Disaster management and emergency response officers
Policy and program officers in government
Public health and community resilience planners
modules: Understanding Global Disaster Risk Reduction Frameworks
The Science and Economics of Risk
Integrating DRR into National and Sectoral Policies
From Disaster Response to Resilient Recovery
Future of DRR: Innovation, Technology, and Climate Integration
prerequisites: Participants are expected to have a foundational understanding of disaster management concepts and familiarity with global development frameworks.
